fact: The Annuaire du commerce extérieur 2023 (June 2024) publishes foreign trade statistics compiled from the customs declarations file supplied monthly by the Burkina Faso customs, with a 2014-2023 series; it is the edition before the 2024 one.
title: Annuaire du commerce extérieur 2023
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique et de la Démographie (INSD)
